content:
Maintenance of add-ons is the responsibility of the add-on developer, not of Thunderbird.

You might consider the add-on "Add-on Compatibility Check", which can warn you of upcoming incompatibilities.

https://addons.thunderbird.net/en-US/thunderbird/addon/addon-compatibility-check/

You should also consider sticking with the Extended Support Release (ESR) release so you're not surprised by unexpected program changes.

https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/thunderbird-esr
creator: rednoise
